275245834.description:
Blank Audio Cassette Tape Lot  13 Tapes
Mixed Brands, 1980s-1990s
TDK, Maxell, Realistic, Certron
A diverse collection of thirteen blank audio cassette tapes featuring leading magnetic media brands from the late 20th century. This lot is notable for containing a high proportion of factory-sealed vintage stock, which remains highly sought after by analog recording enthusiasts for their specific sonic characteristics and period-correct aesthetics. The selection spans various formulations including standard Normal Bias and high-performance Chrome-equivalent tapes.
9 Factory-Sealed tapes and 4 unsealed/opened tapes
Mix of 60-minute and 90-minute recording lengths
Includes Type I (Normal Bias) and Type II (Chrome/High Bias) formulations
Features TDK D90, Maxell UR series, and Realistic Supertape HD-90
Condition:
Nine tapes are factory sealed in original cellophane; several wrappers exhibit light shelf wear, minor corner scuffs, or remnants of vintage retail price stickers. Four tapes are unsealed and housed in standard clear protective cases; the recording status and internal J-card condition of these opened tapes have not been verified. Clear plastic cases on unsealed units show typical surface scuffing and light scratches from storage. Realistic Supertape and one Maxell XLII-S represent the Type II High-Bias media in this collection.
Please Read:
All items are donated and may exhibit signs of wear, including surface dirt, discoloration, scratches, and scuffs. Glassware and dishes may display color fading, crazing, or chips. Clothing items may have loose threads or fabric pilling. The full functionality of electrical items is not guaranteed. Purses may show wear on the bottom edges, corners, and handles. Jewelry metal content and stones have not been tested unless explicitly stated, and stones have not been individually inspected. Items sold in lots have not been counted or sorted and may contain small or damaged pieces. Returns are not accepted for these items.
Please carefully review photos and descriptions prior to bidding. If you have any questions or uncertainties, please contact us by opening a customer service ticket.

275034529.description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.
